claims.text: The FDA label contraindicates acitretin with tetracyclines, the class containing chlortetracycline, because both can increase intracranial pressure.
claims.quote: Since both acitretin and tetracyclines can cause increased intracranial pressure, their combined use is contraindicated

headline.text: The FDA label contraindicates acitretin with tetracyclines because of increased intracranial pressure.

reported.text: The warning covers chlortetracycline through its tetracycline class.

gaps.text: The packet contains no PubMed abstract studying this specific combination.
